anchors.name: SOTA_REF
anchors.derivation: P. Borwein, K.-K. S. Choi, J. Jedwab, "Binary sequences with merit factor greater than 6.34," IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory 50 (2004), 3234-3249, DOI 10.1109/TIT.2004.838341. The paper's headline result is an asymptotic construction family (merit factor > 6.34 in the n -> infinity limit); the specific finite value F=9.5851 at length L=191 (parameter E=1903) is a documented instance from this construction, corroborated independently via web search against low-autocorrelation-binary-sequence (LABS) survey literature discussing lengths in the 191-225 range on 2026-09-06. Disclosed rather than asserted with unearned confidence: this task could not independently confirm that no other published finite-length sequence at some other n>=100 exceeds 9.5851, only that no search result found one.
